test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ______________ Five-Year Plan was the first plan to focus on gender issues, women empowerment and the growing inequalities amongst the states and inter regional disparities.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Fifth Five-Year Plan**, spanning from **1974 to 1978**, was the **first to consider gender issues **in development planning.
 
• Specific measures were implemented to **empower women economically**, **socially**, and **politically**.
 
• The plan aimed for **equity by tackling gender issues**, and **regional disparities**, and **promoting social justice** and **inclusive growth**.
 
• Emphasized **empowering women** through **education, skills training, and economic opportunities**.
 
• The plan was developed against the backdrop of **economic challenges**, including **inflation, food shortages, and a balance of payments crisis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sixth Five-Year Plan**

 
 
• The plan was from **1 April 1980 to 31 March 1985**.
 
• The scheme was based on the **Input-Output model**.
 
• In this plan, the **target growth** rate was **5.2%** and the **actual achievement **was **5.4%**.
 
 
 
• **Third Five-Year Plan**
 
 
• Period - 1960-61 till 1965-66.
 
• The plan aimed to make the **economy reach a state of economic dynamism**.
 
 
 
• **Fourth Five-Year Plan**
 
 
• The scheme started on **1 April 1969 **and ended on **31 March 1974**.
 
• It was a plan based on the **Ashok Rudra Menon model**.
 
• The** target growth rate** in this plan was set at **5.7%**, while the **achievement** was only** 3.3%**
